results.releaseNotes:
The biggest update since launch, built almost entirely from tester and customer requests.

ROCK-SOLID PLAYBACK ON THE ROAD
- Track changes on cellular are now served from a local cache, so tunnels, handovers and weak signal cannot interrupt the music.
- The moment your phone hops between WiFi and cellular is handled gracefully: downloaded music always plays instantly from your device.
- The quality badge now reads the actual playing file, so it always tells the truth.

CARPLAY
- Choose where NaviBeat opens when your car connects: Favorite Artists, Albums, Downloads and more.
- Optional: switch to downloaded music automatically for the whole drive.
- Artist lists show images, respect your sort tags ("Lastname, Firstname" libraries sort correctly), and follow your Show All Album Artists setting.

FOR CLASSICAL LISTENERS
- Multi-movement works render as proper sections, stand-alone tracks stay clearly separate.
- Add a whole work to the queue with one tap.
- Cleaner movement titles and full-length work names.

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY
- Albums can be sorted by Artist.
- Hide Library sections you never use (iPhone, matching the Mac).
- Recently Released can show unplayed albums only.
- Similar Artists can now come straight from your own server: works even with no external services connected, and AudioMuse-AI upgrades it to sonic similarity automatically.
- Upcoming Concerts link on every artist page.

DOWNLOADS AND OFFLINE
- Download your entire library in one tap, on iPhone and Apple Watch.
- Search and A-Z navigation inside Downloads.
- If your server is unreachable, Home shows your downloaded music right away, and a new "Downloaded only" filter browses just what is on your device.

NAVIBEAT MIXES
- With the NaviBeat Mixes server plugin, Home gets a shelf of personal mixes that leads with the right mix for the time of day, with generated cover art and a New Mix button.

Plus dozens of refinements across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch.
results.description:
NaviBeat brings your own music library to every Apple device you own: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch, plus CarPlay, as a single Universal Purchase. Pay once. Own it.

No subscriptions. No ads. No tracking. No NaviBeat cloud. Your music stays on your own server, exactly where you put it. NaviBeat just plays it, beautifully.

ABOUT NAVIDROME

NaviBeat is a premium client for Navidrome, the free and open-source self-hosted music streaming server. You run Navidrome on a NAS, Raspberry Pi, VPS, or any machine you control. NaviBeat connects to it and streams your collection across every Apple device you own. Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic, and any OpenSubsonic-compatible server work too.

ON iPHONE & iPAD
- Full library browsing: artists, albums, playlists, genres
- Voice search and text search with live results
- Now Playing with time-synced lyrics
- Background audio, Control Center, AirPlay, Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- Offline listening: pin a song, an album, a playlist, or a whole artist
- Listening Stats: a 24-hour clock, a weekday heatmap, and your top artists, albums and songs

IN THE CAR

- Full CarPlay support, included in the same purchase
- Your library, playlists, downloads and Now Playing on the car screen
- Voice search that understands the play command in every one of the app's 11 languages, resolved against your own library, not a streaming catalogue

ON MAC

- A real native Mac app, not a phone app in a window
- Mini Player that pins on top of any window
- Keyboard shortcuts, multi-window browsing, directory browsing, desktop widgets
- NaviSyncRock: sync your Navidrome library to a Rockbox player. Your own server does the transcoding, album art is re-encoded so it renders, playlists are written correctly, and plays sync back. A separate one-time in-app unlock.

ON APPLE TV

- Cinema-scale artwork with smart discovery shelves
- Recently Played, Most Played, Rediscover, On This Day, Because You Listened To
- Voice search via the Siri Remote
- Full-screen Now Playing with time-synced lyrics

ON APPLE WATCH

- Now Playing complications on every watch face
- Music stored on the watch and played from the watch, so you can run without your iPhone
- Downloads pulled straight from your server over Wi-Fi

AUDIO

- Selectable high-fidelity playback engine
- 10-band equalizer with presets
- ReplayGain volume normalisation, per track or per album
- Gapless playback
- Streaming quality set separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, across 10 tiers, or send the original file untouched
- Internet radio

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY

- Multi-library Navidrome support: All Libraries, a single library, or any subset, filtered on the server
- Star ratings synced to your server
- Classical music: automatic work and movement grouping
- Optional Last.fm and ListenBrainz integration. Scrobbles route through your own server, never directly from the app.
- Server Health diagnostics: server type, version, OpenSubsonic extensions, scan status

REACHING YOUR SERVER

Built for a locked-down homelab. Custom HTTP headers for Cloudflare Access and Authelia, mTLS client certificates, and access over Tailscale all work, on every platform, with no third-party relay in between.

ELEVEN LANGUAGES

English, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Serbian, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, with an in-app language picker on every platform.

REQUIREMENTS

NaviBeat requires a running Navidrome server (v0.50 or later, free and open source) accessible from your Apple device. Self-host it on a home NAS, a Raspberry Pi, a VPS, or any machine you control. See navibeat.app for setup tips.

NaviBeat is a third-party client and is not affiliated with the Navidrome project.

PRIVACY

NaviBeat collects zero data. There is no NaviBeat backend, no analytics, no telemetry, no third-party SDKs. Your credentials live in your device's Keychain. Your listening history stays on device. See navibeat.app/privacy.

results.releaseNotes:
NEW IN THIS VERSION

iPhone Duo. Folded, the whole app is on the outer screen. Half open, Now Playing splits on the hinge: cover and controls on the left page, lyrics or Up Next on the right. Album and artist pages split too, also when the Duo lies flat.

Manage Playlists. For one song, Add to Playlist shows which playlists already have it. Check or uncheck, then Save. With several songs selected you see "2 of 5 in" for each playlist.

Shuffle Mix can let you choose the first song (Settings). It shows five random songs, you pick one, and the mix plays after it.

Radio Now Playing works like the song screen: the same backdrop and cover styles, swipe the cover for the next station, lyrics for the announced song.

Genres. From a genre, an artist or album shows only that genre's songs, with Show Full Album.

The blurred cover behind Now Playing fades to the next song's cover.

Artwork: Artist pages, Album pages and Now Playing each have their own Squared or Filled choice. Album versions can show, show subtly or hide on grids, lists and search.

Fade on pause and play (Settings, Playback, off by default).

Library Doctor report in Settings, Server and Library: split albums, missing covers, track numbers and more, from your server. Fixes are made on the Mac.

Downloads. A downloaded playlist picks up songs added on the server, and shows Downloaded only when every song is on the phone. Downloads, Artists groups by album artist, with the same grid or list switch as Artists.

Chinese and Japanese karaoke lyrics sweep character by character. Files the iPhone cannot decode, like APE, are converted by the server. An Opus first song is downloaded whole before it plays, so it is not cut short.

ListenBrainz gets a love for every song you starred on the server. Stars reach Last.fm and ListenBrainz from every place you can star a song.

Play on an artist plays all their albums. Rate several selected songs at once.

CarPlay. An album that is not downloaded no longer waits on a server that does not answer, and a downloaded song plays its file when the server is down. With the phone locked and a slow server, resume and covers no longer wait.

AutoMix always finds a next song, also for DJ mixes.

Tap a song in a shuffled queue and it plays without reshuffling. Shuffle off brings the album order back. An album opened from Search goes Back to its artist.

Settings, Lyrics: Blur distant lines. Off makes every lyric line sharp.

Dim version text in song titles (Settings, Appearance, on by default): "(Remastered 2009)" or "- Radio Edit" is lighter and a bit smaller.

Song cover for compilation tracks (Settings, Now Playing, off by default): a song from a compilation shows the cover of its own single or album from Last.fm. On radio, a song you have only on a compilation gets its own cover.

The Apple Watch uses the accent colour you picked on the iPhone. Home Layout says why Because You Listened is hidden when it has nothing to show.

FIXED

The active lyric line is no longer drawn twice for a moment when it changes. Add Album to Playlist works without a paired Apple Watch. Crossfade has no short silence at the switch to the next song. Lyrics translation works again. A song menu no longer jumps back to the top while it is open. Add to Playlist shows each recent playlist once. A playlist edit is refused when the server left missing songs out of the list, so no song is lost. And many smaller fixes.
